expected.title: Rational powers-of-pi volumes of polarized absolutely rigid linear submanifolds in Abelian-differential strata
expected.author: Vincent Koziarz; Duc-Manh Nguyen
expected.difficulty_reason: Kollár's cited curvature-current theorem applies after a suitable extension of the tautological line bundle; it does not itself construct that extension for the noncompact linear submanifold. The author first proves the exact Hermitian volume-to-curvature identity, then constructs a ramified cover and a graph modification followed by resolution that place the line subbundle in the required setting. The degree bookkeeping and integral characteristic class then close the printed rational-power-of-pi volume conclusion.
